name: Monika Hohlmeier - Proposition de résolution
title: REPORT on control, transparency and traceability of performance-based instruments
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position on EU money that is paid out when agreed targets are met, rather than against actual costs. It says this model, first used for the COVID recovery fund, has weak spots: incomplete paper trails, too much reliance on national bodies, and little data on real costs. It asks for tighter checks, shared data systems, public information on who finally receives EU money, and a stronger say for Parliament. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks for stricter rules, shared data systems and public lists of final recipients.
- **Who it affects:** The European Commission, national authorities and auditors, and anyone receiving EU funds.
- **What happens next:** The report is sent to the Council and Commission. Parliament will use these demands in talks on the next long-term EU budget.
